summary: Independent review of the 60-row SILAC phospho SDRF (30 TiO2 runs x 2 channels) found no blocker or important issues. Both producer overrides of Experimental_Design.xlsx were reproduced from primary data: raw headers give RW8=Top10CID/NCE30, RW9=Top10MSA/NCE35, RW10=Top10HCD/NCE45 on all 30 files, and the incorporation search labels A1-A8 Arg6;Lys4 and A9-A16 Arg10;Lys8 with median log2(H/L) 3.7-5.9. Per-channel genotype matches the design sheet and the EB2 pS222 H/L orientation.

reviewer_context.context: Fresh subagent context without the producer transcript. Producer manifest and log treated as untrusted. PRIDE file list, project record, design xlsx, mqpar.xml, raw headers, MaxQuant tables and the PMC full text were all re-fetched into review-phospho-1/.

spec_compliance.evidence: Header compared with the sdrf-tools contract for ms-proteomics@1.1.0 + vertebrates@1.1.0 + clinical-metadata@1.0.0 (the latest released in spec templates.yaml). No required column is missing and none is unlicensed (factor value[genotype] mirrors characteristics[genotype]). Reserved words appear only in columns with allow_not_available=true. Column order is correct. (source name, assay name, label) is unique, and so is (source, biorep, techrep, fraction). Each file has exactly one light and one heavy row. sdrf version v1.1.0. The repeated cleavage-agent column is an intended campaign decision.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Each controlled value was resolved in OLS4 and none is obsolete: NCBITaxon:10090, UBERON:0000956 cerebral cortex, CL:0010012 cerebral cortex neuron, MONDO:0100039 CDKL5 disorder, PATO:0000461 normal, EFO:0005857 mouse embryo stage, EFO:0010806 (descendant of EFO:0009090), MS:1001742, MS:1001251, MS:1001309, MS:1000133, MS:1000422, MS:1000083, MS:1000484 and PRIDE:0000627. UNIMOD 1/4/21/35/188/259/267/481 match their labels with no swap. PSI-MS has no multistage-activation term, so MSA written as CID is justified. sdrf-tools check reported 21/21 terms verified.

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE protocol and PMC10713615 Methods: male E16.5 embryos, Cdkl5 +/Y and -/Y, cortical neurons, Ara-C, K4R6 and K8R10 media, Lys-C + trypsin, TiO2 enrichment, LTQ Orbitrap Velos, Top10 CID 30% / MSA 35% / HCD 45% (ion trap MS2 for CID/MSA, Orbitrap 7500 for HCD), backcrossed into C57 Bl/6. MaxQuant parameters.txt and mqpar.xml: ITMS 0.5 Da, FTMS 20 ppm, main search 6 ppm, fixed Carbamidomethyl, variable Oxidation/Acetyl(Protein N-term)/Phospho(STY), labels Arg6;Lys4 and Arg10;Lys8. Raw headers of all 30 files show LTQ Orbitrap Velos with the method and NCE above and sample names 'DNU7717 TiO2 <C1-C4|E1-E6> <CID|MSA|HCD>', which confirms the activation override against the xlsx. Genotype orientation from Phospho (STY)Sites.txt: Mapre2 S222 H/L is 9.0/5.4/5.8 in E1-E3 and 0.13/0.23/0.24 in E4-E6, and about 1 in C1-C4.

file_mapping.evidence: Fresh PRIDE files/all (projectAccessions = PXD038505) lists 66 .raw files. The phospho SDRF holds 30 (A17-A26 x RW8/RW9/RW10, the same 30 as the mqpar.xml filePaths) and the sibling QC SDRF holds 36 (RW3/RW5). The two overlap in 0 files and leave 0 deposited raws unmapped, with 0 invented. Only vendor .raw files are used.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed from Experimental_Design.xlsx: E1-E3 are light KO / heavy WT and E4-E6 are label-swapped light WT / heavy KO for embryos 1-3 of each genotype. C1-C4 put the same Control in both channels. Every SDRF row matches. Each embryo has one K4R6 and one K8R10 dish (paper), modelled as 2 sources sharing a biological replicate number. Technical replicates 1-3 are the CID, MSA and HCD injections of one eluate, and dissociation method, NCE, MS2 analyzer and fragment tolerance change with them consistently. The split from the QC SDRF is justified: TiO2-enriched runs from the main search versus unenriched incorporation and mixing-check runs from separate QC searches.

omission_safety.evidence: Control 1-4 biology (tissue, cell type, sex, stage, strain, genotype) appears in no source, and those cells are 'not available' rather than guessed. Organism for the controls is inferred from the mouse-only experiment and search. No sample-to-file or channel map, demographic or run was invented. Optional reduction/alkylation columns are omitted rather than filled. The xlsx was overridden only where primary data contradict it.

deterministic_validation.evidence: Ran with flock: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates -t clinical-metadata exited 0 with one warning (C57BL/6 not in NCBITaxon; the template's strain column is free text). sdrf-tools check exited 0 (CLEAN), sdrf-tools score gave 100/100, sdrf-tools structure exited 0. The producer's validate_pinned.py wrapper was not used.

findings.message: CDKL5 deficiency disorder is a developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (an X-linked neurodevelopmental disorder), not a neurodegenerative disease. The caller should confirm with the user that it fits the campaign 'SILAC datasets covering neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson's'. The SDRF itself is correct.
findings.evidence: MONDO:0100039 CDKL5 disorder; paper title 'Epilepsy-linked kinase CDKL5 ...'.

findings.location: characteristics[strain or breed], Cdkl5 KO/WT rows
findings.message: parse_sdrf warns that C57BL/6 is not in NCBITaxon. The column is free text in vertebrates 1.1.0, so no change is required. The paper says the line was 'backcrossed into C57 Bl/6', so it is not a pure inbred line.

K4R6 is a stable-isotope medium-weight label with no K0R0 arm. 'SILAC light' follows the authors and MaxQuant (L=Arg6;Lys4) and is documented in the manifest limitations. Consumers should read the label modification columns, not assume that light means unlabelled.
